context: While building batch 3's own competing-catalysts-inside-window checks, re-fetching ASPN's real filing history (now extended through 2025-03-20 to cover batch 3's own aspn-step3-2025-02-12 candidate) surfaced a real filing that should have appeared in batch 2's own signoff packet for aspn-step3-2024-11-06 but did not: reports/m2-step3-batch2-signoff-packet-2026-10-02.json listed aspn-step3-2024-11-06's competing_catalysts_inside_window as empty.

disposition: Documented as a caveat, not reopened. aspn-step3-2024-11-06 keeps its existing attestations and recorded_result (reports/m2-step3-batch2-complete-events-2026-10-02.json, labels_sha256 16e0a8945fd4f649931c565ec9e67641da76eaec4d99e1d1594b19fbb1e1b315) -- the real computed labels are unaffected by this correction, only the written chronology evidence was incomplete.
process_note: Going forward, build each candidate's own chronology query window wide enough up front to cover its full 20-session reaction window (not just through a round cutoff date chosen for convenience), and double check it against the specific candidate being signed off, not just skim for same-day pairs.
